text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's the end of training. Well then—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are, Trainer! Please come 
along with Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're here, Curren. I was surprised 
when you contacted me out of the blue.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, is the next customer Ayabe?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I just finished up right now! If you need 
hair advice, City-san is your girl~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's City-san's hair salon♪ She opens it 
whenever schedules align, and it's super 
popular~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Listen to this, Trainer. Ayabe-san, just 
yesterday—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
My hair's getting in the way... Maybe I 
should cut it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, the scissors are broken. Guess I 
gotta head to the school store..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Can you believe it? Ayabe-san always used 
to just cut it herself without caring~! 
Even though her hair is so, sooo pretty!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Leave me alone.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, everyone has their own care routine, 
after all. If you're willing to trust me 
with it, I'll answer with results.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san! Just like your legs, when it 
gets damaged, it's sooo much better to 
have a specialist take care of it, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I take care of my legs myself. If this 
isn't about the race, I'm leaving."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Yukino-chan! Taking good care of 
your hair helps in races too, right? Like, 
making it easier to run and stuff.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! When City does my hair, it gets so 
silky smooth that even if the wind blows, 
it goes right back in place!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(...Indeed, changing the shape would 
reduce air resistance...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Including Hishi Ama-san, all the Umamusume 
who frequent it are top-tier!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Which means...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"There's no harm in giving it a try first! 
Right, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: No time like the present, huh!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"There's no harm in giving it a try first! 
Right, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: No time like the present, huh!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Right this way, Ayabe-san!♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, alright. So... Do you have any 
requests?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...As long as I can run fast, that's all 
that matters.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Keep the length the same, treat the 
damaged parts, and thin it out a bit, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, thanks for the commentary. All 
right, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Phew... Trainer, what was the time?
choice_data_list: It's only a little, but it shrunk!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, you really went and ran right after 
I finished cleaning you up.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I only accepted your invitation because 
you said it had to do with racing. In that 
case, there's only one thing to do, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...You never change, seriously~

Afterward, Admire Vega began putting more 
effort into caring for her hair and tail, 
and she grew more radiant with each 
passing day...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yay~♪ While we're at it, let's have them 
do all sorts of things for us!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Things like... huh?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Cut, shampoo, treatment...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I can do head massages too, you know. 
Nothing good comes from a stiff scalp, so 
how about we loosen it up?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If you like it, I can introduce you to a 
salon that specializes in that sort of 
thing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No, not that far...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please~♪ Well then, let's head to the 
washroom!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: H-Hold on...!

Several dozen minutes later— Admire Vega 
returned, her groomed hair and tail 
shining brilliantly. However...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the head massage really did the 
trick~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"You're such a hard worker. I need to make 
sure you relax like this every now and 
then!"

Admire Vega dozed off, nodding off to 
sleep. She must be the type to bottle up 
exhaustion. I resolved to keep a closer 
eye on her.
